content.comment_body: I'm having a similar issue. My PLC is detected but I can't connect it to my laptop. I'm using [product_name] [version_no] software. Any suggestions on resolving this would be appreciated.

If your hardware is the current model ([product_name] [version_no], [article_no]), you will need the corresponding [product_name] [version_no] software. You can download it from [url], but be aware the download is export-restricted. Registration is required, and if you're registering as a private individual, enter "private use" in the company field.

analysis.insight_summary: User can't connect their PLC to the laptop due to a software version mismatch; the installed software version does not support the detected hardware. The solution involves obtaining the correct software version, but users face registration and export restrictions during the download process. The comments emphasize that matching hardware and software versions is essential.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects straightforward connectivity between their PLC and laptop using available software, without version issues or complicated downloads.
